subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Beginning Knowledge: What we need to live
source.subtopic: Different types of food: grains, vegetables and fruit, dairy, fats and oils, meat, fish, poultry, nuts and beans

show.line: Food gives us energy and helps us grow. Grains, fruit, vegetables, dairy, meat and beans!

rounds.prompt: Which gives us protein to grow muscles?
Dairy or meat, fish and poultry?
Name a food that gives you energy.
We only need a little of which group?
rounds.praise: Just a little fat and oil!

rounds.story: Sizwe eats porridge for breakfast and runs all morning. What did the porridge give him?

hints: Grains give energy. Protein helps us grow.
Think where the food comes from.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Milk is in which group?
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Milk is dairy.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Milk, cheese and yoghurt are dairy!

parent_line: Can sort foods into groups and say how food helps us grow.
